channel.title: Wiki
channel.description: 最近的10条笔记 on Wiki

item.title: Wiki
item.description: 这是我的个人知识库，用 Obsidian 写，自动发布到这里。 作者 Chris Pan · GitHub · 个人主页 库里有三种页面： 地图（maps）：一个主题或一个人的入口页，把相关的笔记和来源串起来，并列出还没想清楚的问题。 笔记（notes）：一条一个想法的原子笔记，大多是中英双语，每篇都写了局限。状态都是 draft，意思是还在改。 来源（sources）：读过、看过的文章、访谈、论文的摘要和要点。原文和字幕全文不在这里发布。 可以从这几张地图开始： 张一鸣：从 2010 年的”克己”到 2021 年的”平常心” Elon Musk：有用、第一性原理、ego/能力比 David ...

item.title: A bug you can reproduce on demand is already 90% fixed. Everything before that point is guesswork and guessing scales terribly
item.description: Debugging is mostly the work of getting to a reliable reproduction.

item.title: Every bug anyone hit before you is sitting in the history, and a lot of people don't know how to query it
item.description: A repository’s history already holds the answers to most “why is this here?” and “what broke this?” questions. Most people just never query it.

item.title: Every network call is a coin flip you don't get to see the result of. Write the code that assumes it landed wrong
item.description: Amateur code answers one question: what happens when everything goes right? Production code has to answer the rest.

item.title: If you can't produce a number showing it got faster, you didn't optimize anything. You made the code uglier and effectively told yourself a bedtime story
item.description: Intuition about performance is unreliable, and asymptotic analysis can hide what matters.

item.title: Systems learn by removing the parts that fail
item.description: EN — Taleb, in the prologue of Skin in the Game: “Systems learn by removing parts, via negativa.” A system gets better because its bad parts drop out, not because they get wiser.

item.title: Tools expire, but problems don't. Every tool is an answer to a question that existed before it did
item.description: Every tool is an answer to a question that existed before it.

item.title: You don't learn from the thing working, you learn from the thing not working
item.description: Watching someone else’s code work teaches almost nothing, because the learning happened in the confusion that got edited out.

item.title: Nassim Taleb
item.description: 塔勒布的思维模型，以及库里和它们呼应的材料。目前的来源是正在读的《非对称风险》（Skin in the Game）。Incerto 系列的其他几本还没有入库。 这张地图边读边长：Core Ideas 里”笔记”一列是空的，就表示这个模型还没读到，或者还没提取成笔记。 Core Ideas 按”谁承担后果 → 后果怎样过滤 → 怎样活下来 → 该信谁”的顺序排列。 模型一句话笔记出处对称拿好处的人也要承担坏处；风险转移是隐藏的不对称待提取《非对称风险》风险共担即过滤做错要付代价，系统才会学习；学习靠淘汰，不靠个人变聪明Systems learn by removing the parts tha...
